model_annotation: Figure 3(a) is a line plot illustrating how coverage varies with the number of completions for several model variants. The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (k)” and uses a logarithmic scale with tick labels shown as powers of two from \(2^0\) through \(2^8\). The y-axis is labeled “Coverage” on a linear scale spanning roughly 0.0 to 1.0 with evenly spaced tick marks (visible at about 0.2 intervals). Three lines are shown: a dark-blue solid line with circular markers (Llama-3B) that rises from about 0.4 at \(2^0\) to near 1.0 by \(2^8\); a green solid line with circular markers (Llama-3B + FT) that starts around 0.6 at \(2^0\) and increases to just under 1.0 by \(2^8\); and a light-blue solid line with circular markers (Llama-1B) that increases from roughly 0.3–0.35 at \(2^0\) to about 0.85–0.9 at \(2^8\). All three series show upward trends across increasing \(k\), with the slopes flattening toward higher \(k\) values.
